audit_logs_actor_ck.name: audit_logs_actor_ck
audit_logs_actor_ck.value:
("audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'USER' and "audit_logs"."actor_user_id" is not null)
          or ("audit_logs"."actor_type" <> 'USER' and "audit_logs"."actor_user_id" is null)

carts_owner_ck.name: carts_owner_ck
carts_owner_ck.value: ("carts"."user_id" is not null)::integer + ("carts"."guest_token_hash" is not null)::integer = 1

deliveries_estimate_window_ck.name: deliveries_estimate_window_ck
deliveries_estimate_window_ck.value:
"deliveries"."estimated_delivery_at" is null or "deliveries"."estimated_pickup_at" is null
          or "deliveries"."estimated_delivery_at" >= "deliveries"."estimated_pickup_at"

delivery_quotes_owner_ck.name: delivery_quotes_owner_ck
delivery_quotes_owner_ck.value: ("delivery_quotes"."checkout_vendor_group_id" is not null)::integer + ("delivery_quotes"."vendor_order_id" is not null)::integer = 1

delivery_status_history_actor_ck.name: delivery_status_history_actor_ck
delivery_status_history_actor_ck.value:
("delivery_status_history"."actor_type" = 'USER' and "delivery_status_history"."actor_user_id" is not null)
          or ("delivery_status_history"."actor_type" <> 'USER' and "delivery_status_history"."actor_user_id" is null)

ledger_accounts_owner_ck.name: ledger_accounts_owner_ck
ledger_accounts_owner_ck.value:
("ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'PLATFORM' and "ledger_accounts"."owner_id" is null)
          or ("ledger_accounts"."owner_type" <> 'PLATFORM' and "ledger_accounts"."owner_id" is not null)

ledger_accounts_closed_ck.name: ledger_accounts_closed_ck
ledger_accounts_closed_ck.value:
("ledger_accounts"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "ledger_accounts"."closed_at" is null)
          or ("ledger_accounts"."status" = 'CLOSED' and "ledger_accounts"."closed_at" is not null)

ledger_transactions_posted_at_ck.name: ledger_transactions_posted_at_ck
ledger_transactions_posted_at_ck.value:
("ledger_transactions"."status" = 'PENDING' and "ledger_transactions"."posted_at" is null)
          or ("ledger_transactions"."status" = 'POSTED' and "ledger_transactions"."posted_at" is not null)

order_status_history_entity_ck.name: order_status_history_entity_ck
order_status_history_entity_ck.value: ("order_status_history"."order_id" is not null)::integer + ("order_status_history"."vendor_order_id" is not null)::integer = 1

order_status_history_actor_ck.name: order_status_history_actor_ck
order_status_history_actor_ck.value:
("order_status_history"."actor_type" = 'USER' and "order_status_history"."actor_user_id" is not null)
          or ("order_status_history"."actor_type" <> 'USER' and "order_status_history"."actor_user_id" is null)

orders_money_ck.name: orders_money_ck
orders_money_ck.value:
"orders"."item_subtotal_minor" >= 0 and "orders"."discount_minor" >= 0 and "orders"."delivery_minor" >= 0
          and "orders"."tax_minor" >= 0 and "orders"."service_fee_minor" >= 0 and "orders"."grand_total_minor" >= 0
          and "orders"."grand_total_minor" = "orders"."item_subtotal_minor" - "orders"."discount_minor"
              + "orders"."delivery_minor" + "orders"."tax_minor" + "orders"."service_fee_minor"

outbox_events_lock_ck.name: outbox_events_lock_ck
outbox_events_lock_ck.value:
("outbox_events"."locked_at" is null and "outbox_events"."locked_by" is null)
          or ("outbox_events"."locked_at" is not null and "outbox_events"."locked_by" is not null)

product_variants_dimensions_ck.name: product_variants_dimensions_ck
product_variants_dimensions_ck.value:
("product_variants"."weight_kg" is null or "product_variants"."weight_kg" > 0)
          and ("product_variants"."length_cm" is null or "product_variants"."length_cm" > 0)
          and ("product_variants"."width_cm" is null or "product_variants"."width_cm" > 0)
          and ("product_variants"."height_cm" is null or "product_variants"."height_cm" > 0)

stock_reservations_terminal_timestamp_ck.name: stock_reservations_terminal_timestamp_ck
stock_reservations_terminal_timestamp_ck.value:
("stock_reservations"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "stock_reservations"."consumed_at" is null and "stock_reservations"."released_at" is null)
          or ("stock_reservations"."status" = 'CONSUMED' and "stock_reservations"."consumed_at" is not null and "stock_reservations"."released_at" is null)
          or ("stock_reservations"."status" in ('RELEASED', 'EXPIRED') and "stock_reservations"."released_at" is not null
              and "stock_reservations"."consumed_at" is null)

store_hours_window_ck.name: store_hours_window_ck
store_hours_window_ck.value:
("store_hours"."is_closed" and "store_hours"."opens_at" is null and "store_hours"."closes_at" is null)
          or (not "store_hours"."is_closed" and "store_hours"."opens_at" is not null and "store_hours"."closes_at" is not null
              and "store_hours"."opens_at" < "store_hours"."closes_at")

vendor_offers_money_nonnegative_ck.name: vendor_offers_money_nonnegative_ck
vendor_offers_money_nonnegative_ck.value:
"vendor_offers"."price_minor" >= 0
          and ("vendor_offers"."previous_price_minor" is null or "vendor_offers"."previous_price_minor" >= 0)
          and ("vendor_offers"."cost_price_minor" is null or "vendor_offers"."cost_price_minor" >= 0)

vendor_offers_availability_window_ck.name: vendor_offers_availability_window_ck
vendor_offers_availability_window_ck.value:
"vendor_offers"."available_until" is null or "vendor_offers"."available_from" is null
          or "vendor_offers"."available_until" > "vendor_offers"."available_from"

vendor_orders_money_ck.name: vendor_orders_money_ck
vendor_orders_money_ck.value:
"vendor_orders"."subtotal_minor" >= 0 and "vendor_orders"."discount_minor" >= 0 and "vendor_orders"."tax_minor" >= 0
          and "vendor_orders"."delivery_minor" >= 0 and "vendor_orders"."commission_minor" >= 0 and "vendor_orders"."vendor_net_minor" >= 0
          and "vendor_orders"."vendor_net_minor" + "vendor_orders"."commission_minor"
              = "vendor_orders"."subtotal_minor" - "vendor_orders"."discount_minor" + "vendor_orders"."tax_minor"
